technical_and_design_decisions: Implement Rabbit sink batching using Spring AMQP's batching capabilities with configurable batch size.
Use Gradle's module plugin and Spring Boot's MODULE layout support for the build configuration.
Integrate HDFS dataset acceptance tests into the existing CI pipeline using standard testing frameworks.
Extend compression support by allowing custom compression codecs to be plugged in via configuration.
Reuse existing benchmark infrastructure for performance testing with batching and compression enabled.
Make DB requirement optional by introducing a runtime profile or flag to disable DB initialization.
Implement RxJava-based processor module by adhering to the core module interface contract.
assumptions: The development environment is already set up with Java 17+, Spring Framework 6.0+, and Gradle.
Existing codebase and CI infrastructure are accessible and functional.
Performance benchmark tools and baseline data are available for comparison.
Acceptance tests for HDFS dataset module follow standard Spring testing practices.
Compression customization follows existing patterns from PR #1346.
RxJava 2 or 3 is the target version for the processor module implementation.

activities.activity_description: Add batching support to the Rabbit sink with configurable batch size and enable/disable option.
Create a Gradle build option to support module projects with provided dependencies and MODULE layout.
Write and integrate acceptance tests for the hdfs-dataset module into the CI build.
Allow users to override default compression settings and plug in custom compression codecs.
Rerun baseline benchmarks with Rabbit batching enabled and compare with previous results.
Rerun baseline benchmarks with Rabbit compression enabled and compare with previous results.
